description: Normalise ENS names (ENSIP-15) and compute their namehash and labelhash, e.g. 'Is Nick.ETH a valid name?' or 'What is the namehash of ens.eth?'. Takes up to 50 names; an invalid name returns an error explaining why. Other tools normalise names themselves: use this to check spelling, look-alike characters or hashes. Works offline.
